messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 alert — Hosted API p99 latency > 15s in us-west. Queue depth climbed +4.2k in 10m. Autoscaler errors: rate-limited on instance creates. Paging @eng_oncall_maria @sre_jen @infra_ops

eng_oncall_maria: seeing lots of 502s and client timeouts. p95 jumped from ~200ms to 1.8s, p99 at 18s. Hosted queue backlog at 12k; GPU pool saturation at 98%.

sre_jen: confirmed. provisioner-create API returning 429s and 503s. Graphs: provisioner create_retries spiked, instance_create_failures due to quota/rate-limit.

infra_ops: I can see cloud provider logs showing "RateExceeded: Too many create requests" — they throttled us. Autoscaler is healthy internally but cloud-side throttles prevent new VM/GPU allocation.

ml_nate: traffic profile shows a sudden RTU partner burst around 11:24 UTC — long sequences, high token counts, many concurrent sessions. This is high-cost batchy traffic.

eng_oncall_maria: immediate mitigation options? Can we route some traffic to smaller/quantized variants or to Dedicated customers? Need quick wins to reduce GPU pressure.

infra_ops: options: 1) raise provisioner parallelism (but will hit provider rate limits), 2) temporarily bump autoscaler max_instances down to avoid queue thrashing? that sounds bad, 3) route heavy requests to quantized-small model. Recommend routing <partner_x> to quantized-1.

ml_nate: quantized-1 has ~30% lower throughput but uses half the memory — should help. We have a routing policy that supports tag-based overrides.

eng_oncall_maria: doing routing change now for partner_x via admin API. Command: 
```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' https://console.api.redwood/v1/routing/override -d '{"selector":"partner:partner_x","route":"quantized-1","ttl":300}'
```

deploy-bot: routing override request accepted. Starting policy push to edge routers.

eng_oncall_maria: policy pushed. Observability: queue depth dropping slightly — from 12k -> 9k in 6m. p99 down to ~9s. Still higher than normal.

provisioner-bot: log excerpt: 
```
2026-03-15T11:27:08Z provisioner: createInstance failed id=xyz code=429 msg="Create requests rate-limited by provider"
2026-03-15T11:27:09Z provisioner: retrying backoff=2.1s
2026-03-15T11:29:30Z provisioner: createInstance failed id=abc code=403 msg="QuotaExceeded: GPU quota exceeded"
```

cs_karen: CS note — first customer reports started at 11:30 UTC: latency/timeouts on inference calls. I'm pulling the top 10 impacted accounts now.

pm_lucas: please capture error rates and top impacted endpoints so we can message customers. Ops: do we have an ETA for new capacity?

infra_ops: provider support is rate-limiting API. I opened an emergency support ticket but ETA unknown. We can try: a) shift non-critical workloads to other regions (eu/us-east) b) aggressively drop or slow low-priority tokens with rate-limit policy c) continue model-routing to smaller variants.

eng_oncall_maria: starting traffic shaping for anonymous or low-tier requests: applying rate-limit rule to reduce burst pressure by 30%. Command: 
```json
{ "route": "global-hosted", "token_rate_limit": 0.7, "match": "tier:free OR tier:low" }
```

deploy-bot: rate-limit policy applied.

eng_oncall_maria: after routing + shaping, queue depth down to 4.6k in 10m, p99 ~4.2s, 5xx rate down 65%. Holding on further changes until provider responds.

sre_jen: good short-term progress. We should also enable fallback to CPU-serve for small-context requests to avoid using GPUs for cheap calls — add fallback rule for seq_len <=64.

ml_nate: added a canary fallback rule for short requests. Fallback exposes slightly higher latency but frees up GPU capacity.

cs_karen: update on customers — top affected: AcmeCorp (15% errors), Streamly (9%), PartnerX (internal partner, heavy RTU). We're drafting a status message to impacted customers: mitigation in progress, some degraded performance.

pm_lucas: coordinate with comms + SOC for external notice. Keep top-line that degrade is mitigated and teams working with cloud provider.

infra_ops: provider responded: they increased tenant throttling window and temporarily raised create quota for us (manual override) but they warned about sustained high request spikes. They recommend spreading creations across regions.

eng_oncall_maria: starting scaled-up capacity creation in us-east as a buffer, plus draining smaller-model routing. Triggering provisioner to create 25 instances in us-east.

provisioner-bot: batch create started, showing gradual successes now (creates returning 200). Instance health checks passing.

eng_oncall_maria: new capacity landing — GPU pool utilization down to 72%. Queue depth falling toward steady state 800-1k. p99 trending to ~600-800ms.

sre_jen: recommend keeping rate-limit + routing overrides for 30m and then slowly relax. Also create follow-up infra ticket to adjust autoscaler thresholds (increase max burst, add cross-region spread).

pm_lucas: assigning post-incident action items: 1) evaluate provider quota patterns (infra_ops) 2) add automatic partner throttles for RTU-like bursts (product/eng) 3) update runbook for provisioner 429s (sre) 4) customer comms template (cs).

cs_karen: will send customer note to AcmeCorp & Streamly in next 15m. Internal message drafted for status page.

eng_oncall_maria: final check — p95 now 190ms, p99 780ms, 5xx back to baseline. Marking as mitigated; not resolved until follow-ups done. Handing off to SRE for postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated. Severity lowered to SEV3. Created incident/3967000000 channel and linked follow-up ticket INFRA-5282.

sre_jen: taking handoff for postmortem. Will collect logs, timeline, and config diffs. I'll own the RCA and the action item list.

pm_lucas: thanks team. Good rapid coordination. We'll review in tomorrow's incident review.

cs_karen: CS will follow up with impacted customers and include ETA for permanent fixes.

eng_oncall_maria: leaving on-call notes: routing override + rate-limit applied 11:28–11:58 UTC, provider manual quota bump at 11:36 UTC, cross-region capacity created 11:40–11:50 UTC.

sre_jen: noted. Closing the live thread; keep logs and screenshots in the incident ticket.

provisioner-bot: archived create logs and attached them to INFRA-5282.

eng_oncall_maria: thanks all. :thumbsup:
